'''Pollux Poi''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Anx/Legends|Anx]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who was considered to be both brilliant and insane. He was contracted by the [[Shell Hutts]] to develop [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] to battle the [[Gejalli]] [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidic]]. After upgrading in the [[Builder Forge]], an ancient intelligence that was part of a machine on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] managed to assassinate the third through fourteenth ranking [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] in the line of succession for Gejalli clan head. The Gejalli thus hired [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Shadow Killer]]s to kill the engineer responsible. Hence, Poi fled to the deepest underlevels of [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], where he spent the next twenty years&mdash;which Poi called "the shadow game"&mdash;hiding from the Dashade, with his droid creations acting as his bodyguards. The Dashade's hunt for him soon ended when the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]] was destroyed during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], but Poi himself soon died of natural causes. His droids later became the [[A-series assassin droid]]s.
